name: Karaoke mode playback with line highlighting
description: Test the karaoke playback feature with synchronized text highlighting

planSteps.description: Click any preset topic button to generate a scenario
The practice view loads with dialogue lines and playback controls
Click the large play button in the playback controls
The first dialogue line becomes highlighted with a colored left border
A progress bar shows the current position in the dialogue
Click the play button again to pause playback
Playback pauses and the current highlight remains on the active line
